purpose: Allow P1 smoke execution to start immediately when any required executor categories become S0-ready, while skipping blocked candidates without redesigning the protocol.
scientific_boundary: This matrix does not qualify any executor.
This matrix does not authorize paid or credentialed calls beyond existing project authorization.
Blocked candidates are skipped, not reinterpreted as failures of a treatment.
No holdout task may be accessed.
Executor and verifier bindings must be frozen before each treatment run.

required_categories_for_comparative_smok.economic: one S0-ready C2_ECONOMIC_REMOTE, C3_LOCAL_OPEN_WEIGHT, or C4_FREE_OR_NEAR_FREE-equivalent path

strong: any newly qualified strong path satisfying executor-screening-contract-v1
economic: any newly qualified lower-cost path satisfying executor-screening-contract-v1

skip_rule: If a candidate is credential-, quota-, environment-, install-, licensing-, or telemetry-blocked, record the blocker and advance to the next candidate. Do not weaken S0 qualification to make the matrix executable.

smoke_task_selection.rule: Use the smallest verifier-first subset that covers at least two admitted task families when possible.
smoke_task_selection.one_task_exception: Allowed only for pipeline smoke; no comparative claim.

cells.gate: run only after family policy is frozen prospectively

requires: strong fallback if escalation is part of frozen treatment
cells.gate: skip without penalty if no local/free candidate is S0-ready

paired_shaping_extension.rule: Add only as paired S0/S1 comparison after base smoke path executes reproducibly.

minimum_run_record: explicit telemetry limitation when not exposed
release_rule: Smoke evidence validates the pipeline only. Comparative or architecture claims remain prohibited until later P1 gates are satisfied.
